propositions: S3 backend optional dependency and configuration must be documented in docs/config.md, docs/s3-backend.md, and a new ADR 0092 so operators can discover and configure the feature.

docs/s3-backend.md must document the complete setup: pip install nava-rebar[s3], SSE-KMS bucket creation with IAM/CMK policy, git remote configuration with sync.remote, credentials/encryption trust boundary, and auto-doctor self-heal behavior with 60s stale-lock TTL.

ADR 0092 must record the architectural decision to use git-remote-s3 below the git layer, accept SSE-KMS encryption, employ merge-based auto-doctor instead of upstream's interactive doctor, and justify rejecting TTL lowering.
ADR artifacts (0092 prose file, .numbers/0092 marker, regenerated README.md) must be committed together and pass gen_adr_index.py --check and check_adr_numbers.py validation.
docs/README.md must be updated to link both new documentation pages (s3-backend.md and ADR 0092) for discoverability.
